title: Anal Dilatation for Infants and Children With Constipation
brief_summary: This study is to evaluate the effect of anal dilation in infants and children with constipation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Infants and Children With Constipation
2. Postoperative infants and children with Hirschsprung's disease
3. Good compliance

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Infants and Children With Constipation
2. Poor compliance
